releaseNotes: Keep live text in readable Codex fields: stable words append at the caret without repeatedly selecting or rewriting earlier sentences.
Long-draft and slow-editor handling is improved. If a draft may already be present, recovery offers Copy full text instead of another full-transcript paste.
Committed live words stay fixed; the latest original recognition is available in Recent Dictations. Free, uncapped, locally signed and unnotarized beta.
